summary: For the example, execution capacity is (10 jobs × 5 forks) + (10 × 1) = 60 units and control capacity is 10 units. 1,000 tasks × 300 hosts gives at least 300,000 events per hour, and at about 6 events per task roughly 3,000,000 per hour (833 per second); verbosity raises event counts.
questions: How do I calculate execution capacity for concurrent jobs?
How many job events will my workload produce?
How do I estimate events per second for controller?
